question: For this sealed HIP MI210 Qwen3.8-27B Q8/DFlash2 Q8 full-v10-based candidate, does adaptive width 0..3 meet P9 versus every static width 0..3?
decision_rule: P9 PASS iff all tokens match static-0 (100%), adaptive aggregate request-wall tokens/s >=1.01 times the fastest static width 0..3, and same-request post-exploration zero-to-positive probe recovery occurs within 128 completed rounds. Missing recovery is inconclusive; late recovery or identity/speed threshold violation fails. Malformed/incomplete custody refuses assessment. Descriptive whole-arm timing only; no significance claim.
checkpoints: Persist each request and completed arm. Assess once after all 30 declared requests; preserve partial records on failure. No interim positive performance decisions.
stop_on_answer: Stop after this fixed 5-arm x 2-repetition x 3-prompt schedule and one offline P9 assessment. No automatic reruns or extra samples.
stop_on_futility: Stop immediately on invalid inputs, failed request/arm, journal/custody failure, STOP, grant termination or deadline. Missing recovery at the fixed endpoint is inconclusive; no post-hoc extension.
sufficiency: Expected decision margin +1%; timing noise may exceed it at two repetitions. Report descriptive scoped P9 only, not statistical significance or production promotion. Fixed maximum 7680 generated tokens; no optional stopping for positive speed.
